runSummary.note: Real 17 Sep 05:43 sweep. Twelve independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities, and public Facebook indexing. No promotion-grade new job was found. Upwork surfaced a fresh worldwide WordPress/WooCommerce shop-improvement contract posted 15 Sep at $30 fixed with 5-10 proposals, but it is marked Expert and already has 5 interviews/6 invites, so it was not promoted. The older WooCommerce Product Listing & Upload Specialist remains verifiable but is three weeks old with 20-50 proposals and one hire. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Interview saturation decay
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Down-rank freelance jobs when the client already has a large active interview set relative to proposal count. A fresh 5-10 proposal listing with 5 interviews is materially less actionable than raw proposal count suggests.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Fixed-budget scope-risk detector
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Estimate scope ambiguity for fixed-price WordPress/WooCommerce jobs and penalize low fixed budgets when the description bundles speed, design, shop setup and ongoing monitoring without clear deliverables.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER is attempted where full round-trip content cannot be guaranteed.
